title: Part not applicable to family burial plots.
bodyText: Nothing in this part shall apply to land altering activities related to family burial plots under section 441-5.5.
bodyHtml: [§6E-75]  Part not applicable to family burial plots.  Nothing in this part shall apply to land altering activities related to family burial plots under section 441-5.5. [L 2005, c 128, pt of §1]
